exposure: pre-operative rectal misoprostol in addition to active management of third stage of labour
active management of third stage of labour alone
cohort: Women with uncomplicated singleton pregnancies at >37 completed weeks gestational age undergoing elective cesarean section.
finding: While the reduction in overall blood loss was not statistically significant with the addition of misoprostol to active management of third stage of labour (AMTSL) during elective LSCS, the need for blood transfusions and additional uterotonics was significantly reduced.
